authorization.authorized_action: build and inspect the two pinned Phase 3C VRTSIM runtime images on the reserved x86_64 cell node
authorization.authorization_basis: the user prepared the reservation, requested continuation, and asked to be notified before it became necessary

required_outputs: UE and gNB image IDs, sizes, architectures and revision labels
runtime binary and libvrtsim existence checks
ldd checks with zero unresolved dependencies

preflight_rules: all frozen local and copied remote file checksums must match
the source checkout must resolve to the pinned OAI revision before patching
the cell node architecture must be x86_64
the currently running gNB and UE image IDs and restart counts must be recorded
the build must not replace, restart, stop, or reconfigure any running service
stopping_rules: stop on any source revision or file checksum mismatch
stop if the source clone is not self-contained
stop on any patch, compiler, Docker, runtime artifact, architecture, label, or ldd failure
stop if any running gNB or UE image ID or restart count changes
do not deploy either newly built image regardless of the build result

post_build.pass_action: record image provenance and freeze a separate Phase 3C4 replay execution amendment
post_build.fail_action: keep the replay gate closed and debug the build offline
